# Forest trace validator inputs

These three recorded controller traces exercise `tests/test_level_design_contracts.py`: accepted traversal, missing anchor, and absent hook. They are test inputs, not current gameplay acceptance or world design authority. Current native checks use `forest-current-slice` and `forest-historical-slice` with explicit independent fixtures.

Original bytes: main `83a149558e670fc78a177d8f4662a0ec079b4cbf`, former `docs/evidence/region_production_v3/forest_h_slice/native/{positive,missing-anchor,no-hook}/capture.json`. Logs, movies and producer snapshots were discarded.
